title: Input symbol at a position
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean list and $p$ a natural-number position. The input symbol at $p$ is absent when $p=0$ or $p=|x|+1$; otherwise it is the symbol of $x$ at index $p-1$, using false when that index is out of range.
